statement: Under the **AI Act** (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) an AI system is **high-risk** where it is a safety component of, or is itself, a product covered by Annex I Section A Union harmonisation legislation that requires third-party conformity assessment — the MDR is listed (Annex I, Section A, point 11).
